issuer: the Registrar under the Vehicle and Traffic Act 1999 (Tasmania)
note: Read 2026-10-30 in the Vehicle and Traffic (Driver Licensing and Vehicle Registration) Regulations 2021 (S.R. 2021 No. 26), the whole text as in force on Tasmanian Legislation Online (authorised version of 2026-08-17). The age: reg. 8(2), before a full car licence a novice driver completes the learner, P1 and P2 stages in order; reg. 23(1)(b)(iii), a provisional licence from 17; reg. 16(2), the P1 is held at least 12 continuous months and the P2, for a person under 23 when obtaining it, at least 2 years; so the full licence is held from 20 at the earliest (an age built from the stages, as the ACT's, Victoria's and Western Australia's were; a person first licensed at 23 or more waits less, 12 months on the P2 or to 25, which the form doesn't hold). The term: reg. 31(1), a driver licence is issued for a term of years of not less than one and not more than 5 years, as specified in it, so the years stand null (the holder's term isn't one number). The fee: Schedule 1, Part 1, item 4(b), the issue or renewal of a driver licence (not a learner's or provisional) for 12 months 20.76 fee units, 2 years 33.76, 3 years 46.76, 4 years 59.76, 5 years 71.76 (item 4(a), pensioners and others, less); Tasmania's fee unit isn't a unit the game holds, so the fee stands null (and with it the terms, which the form takes only with their fees). Reg. 164: a person of 65 or over is exempt from the licence fee for the issue or renewal of a driver licence (not held). The Registrar is the regulations' issuer of licences throughout; the Department that houses the office (Service Tasmania's and Transport Tasmania's pages answered Cloudflare's challenge, as in waves 12 and 13) wasn't read. The Tasmanian personal information card wasn't read: no card.

sources.said: Vehicle and Traffic (Driver Licensing and Vehicle Registration) Regulations 2021 ... 2026-08-17 ... Vehicle and Traffic Act 1999 ... Before being eligible to be issued with a full licence in relation to a car, a novice driver must complete the following novice licensing stages, in ascending order: (a) novice driver learner stage; (b) P1 stage; (c) P2 stage. ... (iii) in the case of a provisional licence, the age of 17 years; ... (a) a P1 provisional licence for at least 12 continuous months; and ... (i) in the case of a person aged less than 23 years at the time of obtaining the P2 provisional licence, 2 years; ... a driver licence other than a driver licence receipt, is to be issued for a term of years specified in the licence of not less than one year and not more than 5 years. ... SCHEDULE 1 - Fees ... Fee units ... Issue or renewal of a driver licence (other than a learner licence or provisional licence) – ... (b) in any other case where the licence is issued or renewed for – (i) 12 months 20.76 (ii) 2 years 33.76 (iii) 3 years 46.76 (iv) 4 years 59.76 (v) 5 years 71.76 ... a person who has attained the age of 65 years is exempt from the licence fee payable on an application for the issue or renewal of a driver licence.
